tasks.title: forge project audit (contract-driven detector)
tasks.objective: Add forge project audit in a new forge_cli/project.py (registered in forge.py). It COMPOSES the harness's current validators so it auto-reflects future changes: done-story completeness (reuse check_board_complete logic), pending-story shape (a NON-FATAL collector factored from roadmap.py check_story_contract's field list, not a copy), and vendor drift (check_vendor_integrity.integrity_problems). Human summary + structured list; pure/local; exit non-zero iff gaps.
acceptance_criteria: forge project audit reports done stories missing pr-link/outcome/history, pending stories missing epic/skill/acceptance_criteria/spec, and vendor/gate drift, composing the existing validators (not a hardcoded checklist).
It is pure over local inputs (no network) and exits non-zero iff any gap exists; a clean repo exits zero.
The pending-story field list is FACTORED from check_story_contract (shared), so a new required field is detected without editing the audit; check_story_contract's fail-behaviour is unchanged.
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "project_audit"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Composes existing validators (no duplicated truth); field list factored from check_story_contract; pure/local; exit code semantics; no behaviour change to check_story_contract's fail().

tasks.title: forge project backfill + continuous cadence
tasks.objective: Add forge project backfill in project.py: for each done story lacking a pr-linked event, recover the PR from GitHub via an injectable gh seam, matching the key as PR-title prefix or feat|fix/<key>-* branch; unique -> forge pr-link; ZERO -> mark predates; TWO+ -> report+skip (never guess). Reconstruct missing card fields ONLY from committed evidence (archived plan / history decomposition). Idempotent. Wire forge project audit into harness-health.yml's scheduled run.
acceptance_criteria: backfill links a recoverable done story via forge pr-link (unique GitHub merge-record match), marks a ZERO-match story predates_outcome_contract, and reports+skips a TWO+-ambiguous story without guessing; no PR number is fabricated.
Missing card fields are reconstructed ONLY from committed evidence (archived plan / history decomposition); an evidence-less stub is left marked, never invented.
backfill is idempotent (already-linked stories skipped); the gh call is an injectable seam so tests use a fixture, not the network.
harness-health.yml runs forge project audit alongside its machinery version-check on the existing schedule (detection only, no auto-write).
verify_commands: uv run --with pytest python -m pytest factory/tests/test_gates.py -q -k "project_backfill or harness_health"
tasks.reviewer_focus: Honesty is the bar: never fabricate a PR number or a card field with no evidence; ZERO->predates, TWO+->report+skip; gh seam injectable; idempotent; harness-health runs the audit (detection only, no auto-apply).
